Our Story

The mandate stands.
Now we build.

For eleven years, Rickey Jay Bennett II preached the Word of God on the streets of America. Not from a pulpit. Not with a salary or a congregation or a denominational charter behind her. She preached from sidewalks and shelters and bus stations — with only a Bible and a conviction that would not leave her alone.

The conviction was this: that work is sacred. That the capacity for productive, skilled, dignified labor is not a feature of economic life but a feature of human nature — given by a Creator God who worked in the beginning, before sin entered the world.

The Thessalonian Mandate Institute was not born in a boardroom or a seminary or a nonprofit incubator. It was born in the understanding that the work mandate of 2 Thessalonians 3:10 is not a comfort. It is a command — and a command carries with it a corresponding obligation.

The mandate stands. Now we build.

The Minister

Rickey Jay Bennett II

Founder · Minister · Chief Executive · Secretary · Treasurer

An independent minister, street preacher, and researcher whose work spans artificial intelligence, philosophy of mind, and the theology of human labor. She founded the Institute on the conviction that the Church is obligated to equip those who are willing to work but cannot — and built it as the thing that should have already existed.

Legal Foundation

The Thessalonian Mandate Institute is a Faith-Based Organization established in Austin, Texas, operating under the automatic tax exemption of 26 U.S.C. § 508(c)(1)(A). EIN issued by the Internal Revenue Service. All operations are subordinate to the theological convictions set forth in the Statement of Faith and Theological Framework.

Support the Work

Every dollar
equips a willing worker.

The Institute charges nothing to its students. Every program, every credential, every hour of support is free. That is only possible because of people who understand the obligation to equip.

$25
Supports one student
Covers one week of case management and accountability support for a student in active training.
$150
Funds one pathway
Covers the full cost of shepherding one student through a complete certification pathway from intake to placement.
$500
Launches one cohort
Funds the intake, assessment, orientation, and first month of support for a full cohort of 8–15 participants.

Grant & Partnership Opportunities

The Institute actively pursues partnerships with workforce development boards, foundations, and corporate giving programs.
